title: Get a permit to organise a market
what: Get the council's permit before organising a market in a public place.

laws.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010

sources.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010
sources.locator: by-law 18(1) (version as in force at 5 August 2010)
sources.quote: (1) A person or body must not, without a permit, organise or attempt to organise a market in a public place.
